learning_outcomes.text: Students know the relevance of national and international patent systems, including the various industrial property rights in the technical and aesthetic fields.
Students have detailed knowledge in some special disciplines.
Students know and apply common tools for information retrieval in patent law.
Students integrate findings from patent searches and apply them to new tasks.
Students present specific results from patent searches to a professional audience.

syllabus_topics: Overview of the most important types of industrial property rights
Searches in the prior art using national and international databases
Course of the patent granting, utility model registration, and design registration procedures
Subject matter of a protected patent
Effect and scope of protection of a patent
Patentability of inventions in the field of computer programs, gene and biotechnology, medical procedures
Legal regulations of employee invention law
Product and innovation management through industrial property rights
assessment_rules: The written examination details are subject to the respective valid study regulations.
bibliography: Beck-Texte im dtv Patent- und Musterrecht, neueste Auflage.
